town_description: Ambala is a city and district headquarters in northern Haryana, divided into Ambala City and Ambala Cantonment (a major British-era military station). It is a major railway junction and lies on National Highway 44, about 45 km from Chandigarh.

travel.railway: Ambala Cantonment Junction (major rail hub, ~7 km from Ambala City)
travel.road: Ambala lies on NH-44; well connected by road to Delhi, Chandigarh and Punjab
